story: The Halo Drive: Fuel-Free Relativistic Propulsion (2019)
text: Prof. Kipping is well known for his Cool Worlds youtube channel, which is fantastic. He created a video on his Halo Drive idea: [VIDEO]

story: Ways to travel at nearly the speed of light
text: The halo drive concept is interesting. It uses a beam of light to extract gravity energy from a black hole and use to to maintain acceleration of your ship. Almost no fuel needed because its really just a kind of extreme gravity assist that we’ve been doing since what, the 1970s? [VIDEO]

story: A Dyson sphere around a black hole
text: also, you can use light, instead of matter. Termed the "halo drive", it's a very nice theoretical concept: [VIDEO]

If you have the technology to reach the nearest binary blackhole ( "you just have to pay the one-time fee of the cost to reach the nearest binary black hole system" , at 16:12 min in this video: [VIDEO] ), you can most likely deal with the mirror/energy harvesting problem as well.
